title: Teams Premium: who needs the add-on licence, and what does it unlock?
summary: Hold: the checklist tells administrators to license town hall organisers for Teams Premium even though Microsoft now documents event entitlements under other licences. The page also overstates Premium-only licensing and policy requirements, omits trial and partner-role qualifications, and treats documented licensing information as unanswered.
